A 2026 Optimizely Digital Healthcare Strategy Playbook
U.S. healthcare digital experience has been under
tremendous pressure for more than a decade,
and the challenges keep piling up.
Asked to do more with less, to be strategic at every
turn, and to blend effective marketing with service
design, CMOs, CIOs, CTOs and their teams face an uphill
battle. Healthcare business models are under great
pressure, competition is fierce and growing, regulations
are shifting, and consumer expectations are set not by
healthcare competitors but rather by the largest digital
In this environment, the usability, accessibility and power
of tools provide crucial leverage for smaller, overtasked
teams. But great, user-friendly technology is not
enough. Organizations must develop an effective digital
practice and associated strategies to get the value out
of technology, which has little value without it. However,
A strong jump start is essential to build momentum.
